description: Implementation of Montgomery arithmetic functions for big number operations in cryptography, including context management, conversion, and multiplication routines.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Montgomery context.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_copy
methods.description: Copies Montgomery context data from one to another.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_set
methods.description: Sets up Montgomery context with a modulus.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_new_for_modulus
methods.description: Creates a new Montgomery context for a given modulus.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_new_consttime
methods.description: Creates a new Montgomery context with constant-time setup.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_set_locked
methods.description: Thread-safe setup of Montgomery context with locking.

methods.name: BN_to_montgomery
methods.description: Converts a number to Montgomery form.

methods.name: BN_from_montgomery
methods.description: Converts a Montgomery number back to standard form.

methods.name: bn_one_to_montgomery
methods.description: Initializes a BIGNUM to represent 1 in Montgomery form.

methods.name: bn_less_than_montgomery_R
methods.description: Checks if a BIGNUM is less than R in Montgomery context.

methods.name: bn_to_montgomery_small
methods.description: Converts small number array to Montgomery form.

methods.name: bn_from_montgomery_small
methods.description: Converts small Montgomery number array back to standard form.

methods.name: bn_mod_mul_montgomery_small
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication on small number arrays.
